summary.ko: Builds a 16:9 deck as HTML from three visual styles. A sample image can become the template. index.html shows the render, and yes prints the PDF and, when asked, PowerPoint.

knowledge.name: deck kit
knowledge.description: Page types, components, the blank deck, and the component catalog for a 16:9 deck.

contents.description: Blank 16:9 deck. Copy this file to start a new deck. It carries the master design.
Every page template and component, with the markup to copy into a deck.
Blank 16:9 deck in Swiss Grid style: cream paper, black rules, red signal color, and square geometry.
Page templates and components rendered in the matching Swiss Grid style.
Blank 16:9 deck in Night Console style: dark data-room surfaces, cyan signals, and technical geometry.
Page templates and components rendered in the matching Night Console style.
Blank 16:9 deck in Paper Atelier style: warm paper, serif display type, and organic editorial forms.
Page templates and components rendered in the matching Paper Atelier style.
